Grandpa Zhang looks at the rich dinner prepared by Xiao Hong and says with emotion, "Today's dishes are just like a colorful painting!"

[Question]
Why does Grandpa Zhang say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He thinks the color combination of the dinner is too monotonous.
B. He thinks the taste of the dinner is as fragrant as a painting.
C. He praises Xiao Hong for being very hospitable and cooking delicious food.
